notes.title: UPDATE 1.0.2 Bug Fixes
notes.notes: [p]ULTRA CORE DIVE Update 1.0.2  [/p][list][*][p]Fixed the issue when soft resetting the game ( whether it was through pause menu, or beating the game ) caused the achievement gates to crash the game. [/p][/*][*][p] Fixed some menu sounds [/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]There was also an emergency patch uploaded on June 22nd.  Incase you missed it here are the notes for that:  [/p][list][*][p]Fixed the issue where the upgrade randomizer "runs out of upgrades" and crashes the game.[/p][/*][*][p] Changed some terminology on some of the upgrades  [/p][/*][*][p]Added more special weapon containers on the last zone  [/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]Thank you for your patience![/p]
